status: frozen analytical candidate; product agreement and independent scrutiny recorded separately
governing_sources: execution/PKG-03/DEL-03-05/Work/eccentric-reducer-offset.md §2, §3.2 (absent vs zero offset; end sizes descriptive)
independence: standard library only; no product code, product output or frozen product reference is imported, read or run; all data invented

model.theory: small-displacement linear elastic collinear straight members; axial problem only (transverse and rotational DOFs unloaded, exactly 0); shear-model independent
model.constitutive: s*E*A_n*eps = N_w - 2*nu*p*A_i; N_w = N_m + 2*nu*p*A_i; S = N_w - p*A_i (s = DEC-045 scale; Poisson pair has no E)
model.caps: -p*A_i*s at each transfers_to_wall terminal, s the unit vector from the node into the member; implicit junction = node where two or more regions end
model.d5: A_n (nominal wall) for stiffness; A_i = pi*r_i,r^2 (pressure bore) for caps and the Poisson pair; sigma_m = N_w/A_b per basis; Lame per basis's own annulus: radial -p inner, 0 outer; hoop outer 2p*r_i,b^2/(r_o^2-r_i,b^2), inner = outer + p
model.end_sizes: descriptive only; never enter a number (bores come from the member sections)

formulations.A: closed form: sum S_k s_k = 0 at free nodes, S = 0 beyond free capped terminals, series compatibility between far anchors; left/right chain terms, no member orientation
formulations.B: assembled exact 1-D axial stiffness with member direction cosines, held Poisson end actions, caps as nodal loads, Gauss-Jordan over Fractions, R = K u - f

model.exact_form: q*pi^k with q rational; forces k=1, displacements and stresses k=0; 'value' is the nearest binary64, decided by rational pi bounds 2e-100 apart

cases.label: R2A-FREE-N
cases.purpose: reducing; junction N (upstream pipe to body) anchored; far ends P, Q free and capped; F free (R-4 C-3)

results.transverse_and_rotations: exactly 0 at every node (unloaded collinear chain)

members.note: equivalent mapped-section (reference pipe) rows under the body's forces, not a reducer body or taper stress (DEL-03-05 §2.4, component_body)
